text: Fujian Medical University (FMU) is located in Fuzhou（福州市）, Fujian Province. Fuzhou is the capital city of Fujian, with a history of more than 2,000 years, flaunting its modern cityscape. Intake: March, 2023 Tuition fee: 9000RMB/Semester Teaching Medium: English Duration: One semester (After pre-medicine study, you will have a greater chance of being admitted to an MBBS program)
